parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the cluster for image security scanning.

parameters.name: Dealed
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the event is handled. Valid values:
- **Y**: Handled. 
- **N**: Not handled. 
- **A**: All.

parameters.name: ImageDigest
parameters.description: The SHA256 value of the image digest.

parameters.name: RepoId
parameters.description: The ID of the container image repository.

parameters.name: RepoInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the container image.

> Invoke the [DescribeImageInstances](~~DescribeImageInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: RepoRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the container image repository.

parameters.name: Uuids
parameters.description: The instance ID for image security scanning.
